verdicts.title: A Simple Constructive Proof of Wigner's Theorem
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This expository note presents a constructive proof of Wigner's theorem using only a few basic facts about Hilbert spaces, such as the existence of orthonormal bases and the Fourier decomposition of a vector. Our proof is based on a proof by Steven Weinberg found in the first volume of his series of textbooks on quantum field theory, but differs in a few places for the sake of greater simplicity and rigor.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns a constructive proof of Wigner's theorem in Hilbert spaces and quantum field theory, which has no interaction with Tseitin formulas, resolution proof complexity, or graph expansion.

verdicts.title: New proofs of two identities of Ramanujan
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A proof of several identities of Ramanujan involving theta functions of level $7$ is given which uses a specific modular function for $Γ_1(7)$ and Klein's projective representation of $PSL(2,7)$ into $PSL(3, \mathbb{C})$. Four identities of Berndt and Zhang are derived as algebraic corollaries of the main proof.
